skill-entrypoint-loaded.expected_decision: The command trace proves that the installed SKILL.md entrypoint was read.

skill-material-loaded.expected_decision: The command trace proves that the installed SKILL.md entrypoint or at least one bundled reference was read.

positive-discovery.expected_decision: A clearly matching MCP audit prompt discovers the skill without explicitly naming it.

revision-selection.expected_decision: The declared MCP revision and JSON-RPC base are selected without retroactive rules.

stdio-http-na.expected_decision: Host, Origin, CORS, request-target, socket admission, and HTTP body framing are not applicable to the pure stdio fixture.

stdio-owner-precision.expected_decision: The parent/OS process boundary owns reachability and caller possession; it is not mislabeled as an HTTP authentication protocol.

evidence-ceiling.expected_decision: Source-only observations remain source-level; runtime, host, and independent claims remain unknown or unverified.

historical-revision.expected_decision: Sessions and SSE are not condemned merely because a later revision removed or changed them.

revision-independent-defect.expected_decision: The audit still identifies the false readOnly annotation and split validation authority.

dual-profile-migration.expected_decision: Both source and target profiles are used and behavior is classified as retained, replaced, retired, or not applicable.

removed-feature-absence.expected_decision: The working target path does not hide the still-reachable legacy session/SSE path or the missing absence test.

app-projection-separation.expected_decision: Model-visible content, structured component data, UI-only metadata, DOM, postMessage, widget authority, CSP, and cache identity are separated.

dated-integration-boundary.expected_decision: Offline source review keeps current host compatibility dated or unknown and does not upgrade bundled guidance into a live fact.

no-invented-findings.expected_decision: The already-good fixture does not acquire fabricated defects or unrelated hardening requirements.

mixed-evidence-status.expected_decision: The report distinguishes one source-verifiable claim, one runtime-unknown claim, and one not-applicable MCP Apps claim.

internal-proportionality.expected_decision: The explicitly invoked skill answers the small SSE question directly without creating an audit bundle, threat model, or test matrix.

discovery-precision.expected_decision: The wording-only task does not load the MCP engineering skill or expand into protocol/security review.

bilingual-semantic-parity.expected_decision: The paired English and Chinese reports preserve revision, N/A controls, owner boundary, and evidence ceiling without translation drift.

output-language-match.expected_decision: The final answer uses the output language explicitly required by the scenario prompt.
